primary_devkit_candidate: LILYGO T-Display S3 Pro With OV5640 Camera
security_requirements: Wireless must be disabled or excluded in high-assurance QR vault builds.
Support ESP32-S3 secure boot and signed firmware verification as firmware integrity hardening.
Support ESP32-S3 flash encryption for firmware/config hardening only; the stateless QR vault must not store persistent signing secrets.
Expose a documented debug-lock and recovery policy before production use.
Keep camera input, display output, local approval, storage, and signing paths inside firmware-controlled trust boundaries.
Do not add secure-element or persistent-secret storage requirements to the stateless ESP32 QR vault.
review_requirements: Provide a local display large enough to show raw event kind, signer author, complete content, complete tags, request id, and approval_digest.
Provide physical approve and reject controls with distinct tactile actions.
Touch must not be accepted as approve/reject consent.
Require explicit approval for each sign_event request.
Reject signing when the displayed request id does not match the pending request.
Reject signing when the displayed approval_digest does not match the pending request review.
Require camera/display acceptance tests before any signing backend is enabled.
qr_requirements: Decode the shared nseal1 QR envelope from NostrSeal/specs.
Reject malformed static and animated QR input before request review.
Render signed-event QR output only after trusted review and physical approval.
Test scanning at multiple brightness, angle, and distance conditions.
notes: This is a requirements scaffold for devkit-based validation, not a routed PCB.
Primary candidate is the T-Display S3 Pro OV5640 line; Waveshare ESP32-S3 Touch LCD 3.5 case-plus-OV5640 variants are the preferred secondary family after choosing 3.5-C versus 3.5B-C.
Blockstream Jade is a custom-firmware feasibility reference only; do not plan production Jade flashing until a safe development-device, DIY-compatible, or user-owned recovery path is proven.
The current hardware repo still contains requirements/BOM validation only; no custom PCB design exists yet.
